Name: Yolkies Pixel Portraits for SVE
Author: volkies
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=6][b]DISCLAIMER! AI USAGE![/b][/size][/color]

[size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]You [/size][/color][color=#cc0000][size=4]MUST[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url] installed for this to function as all portrait images are 256x256. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]You can install it like any other mod. 

Installation path should be: Stardew Valley > Mods > [P] YolkiesPixelPortraits[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Open a dialogue box with an NPC and [b]press "P"[/b] to swap the Portrait set being used.[/size][/color]

[b][size=5]Troubleshooting[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]If pressing "P" does not work, [/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]go into your SMAPI console and type in "[/size][/color][color=#f1c232][size=4]pmenu[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]" this will open up Portraiture's UI and allow you to select "[/size][/color][color=#f1c232][size=4]yolkies.YolkiesPixelPortraits[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]". [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]For[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] "[/size][/color][color=#a61c00][size=4]Seasonal Outfit - SVE[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]" users, you can use my portrait pack with it as in it won't break anything, and the overworld sprites should work perfectly fine. But my mod only covers base SVE portraits not those added by Seasonal Outfits.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]If issues with Vortex happen, try installing the mod manually instead.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Patched version of PortraiturePlus is required for Shop NPC Portraits.[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Original mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534[/url]
Source code:
[url=https://github.com/Arborsm/PortraiturePlus]https://github.com/Arborsm/PortraiturePlus[/url]
PortraiturePlus is licensed under the MIT License.
My version includes bug fixes and compatibility changes for Shop NPCs in Stardew Valley Expanded.
Copyright (c) Arborsm and contributors.
A copy of the original MIT license is included with download of modified PortraiturePlus.[/size][/color]

[size=5][b]Characters Covered[/b][/size]
[size=4]Marriage Candidates[/size]
[b][size=3]Victor, Sophia, Scarlett, Olivia, Martin, Magnus/Wizard[/size][/b]
[size=3](may revisit Sophia's Portraits in future, not happy with quality it came out to) [/size]

[size=4]Befriendable NPCs[/size]
[size=3][b]Susan, Morris, Morgan, Marlon[/b][/size]

[size=4]Antisocial NPCs[/size]
[size=3][b]Alesia, Mermaid (Wizard 14Heart Event)[/b][/size]

[size=4]Shop NPCs - Requires Modified PortraiturePlus DLL[/size]
[b][size=3]Zoey/Joja Cashier, Suki/Travelling Merchant, Sandy[/size][/b]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]My goal is to cover all of Stardew Valley Expanded, but even with AI assistance the process takes a long time. It will cover the portraits that come with base SVE (including the Winter & Beach/Ginger Island variants).[/font][/size][/color]

[size=3][font=Arial][color=#D4D4D8]AI is not perfect in anyway. The most time consuming part of creating any of this was fixing issues the AI spat out by manually drawing over it. Of course AI art is not going to be perfect, I tried my best to make the portraits unique, while still trying to keep resemblance between the images, but there will be a lot of small details that will look wrong if you stare too long and some same face syndrome.[/color][/font][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][font=Arial]While with AI the process of completing portraits is much faster than purely by hand, it is still a lengthy process considering how many characters need to be covered, so I can't really give an ETA on finishing.[/font][/size][/color]

Downloads.Description:
Unzip and replace DLL inside of Stardew Valley\Mods\PortraiturePlus with the DLL from this mod.

Patched version of PortraiturePlus that fixes an issue with some modded NPC shops not getting their portraits set.

https://github.com/Arborsm/PortraiturePlus
